CREATE TABLE hvlstajproject.appointment ( id bigint generated by default as identity,
patient_id bigint not null, doctor_id bigint not null,
appointment_date date not null, appointment_time time without time zone not null, status varchar(20) not null default 'BEKLEMEDE',
constraint pk_appointment primary key (id),
constraint fk_appointment_patient foreign key (patient_id) references hvlstajproject.patient (id),
constraint fk_appointment_doctor foreign key (doctor_id) references hvlstajproject.doctor (id),
constraint uk_appointment_doctor_datetime unique (doctor_id,appointment_date,appointment_time),
constraint uk_appointment_patient_datetime unique (patient_id,appointment_date,appointment_time),
constraint chk_appointment_status check (status in ('BEKLEMEDE','ONAYLANDI','TAMAMLANMIŞ','İPTAL')) );
